I chose this clinic because it is a nonprofit organization with a good reputation, high reviews, and reasonable pricing. I had high expectations and was grateful to finally secure an appointment after waiting for a long time.

Today’s appointment was for my puppy’s medical concern. I traveled from quite far away, and the round trip took more than two hours. I left home early to make sure I would arrive on time.

Unfortunately, due to unexpected road construction, a changed route, and rush-hour traffic, I realized I would be delayed. As soon as I knew I might be late, I contacted the clinic in advance to let them know that I was still coming and would only be a few minutes late. I wanted the staff to know that I was not going to miss the appointment or simply not show up — I was making every effort to get there despite circumstances beyond my control.

This was my first time visiting the clinic, so I was also unfamiliar with the area. In the end, I arrived about 15 minutes after my scheduled appointment time. I sincerely apologized and explained the situation to the staff. I also told them that I was willing to wait for any available time later that day because I did not want this long trip to be wasted.

I understand that clinics need to maintain their schedules and respect other patients’ appointment times. However, I was disappointed that there was no flexibility in this situation. During my previous visits for my puppy’s vaccinations and other appointments, we also had to wait even when we arrived on time, which I completely understood. That is why I hoped for the same understanding when I was only slightly delayed due to unexpected circumstances. I was not asking to be seen immediately or to interrupt other appointments — I was willing to wait.

The alternative suggestion was to try another hospital, but that was not a realistic option at that moment. I was unfamiliar with the area, finding another appointment on short notice was extremely difficult, and my puppy had already been in the car for a long time. He became carsick and vomited during the trip, and I was also exhausted and physically unwell from the long drive.

In the end, my puppy was not able to receive the medical evaluation we came for. I also still had to pay the examination fee despite my puppy not being seen. After spending so much time traveling, dealing with the stress of the situation, and seeing my puppy become sick from the car ride, this experience was extremely disappointing and upsetting.

I hoped that an animal hospital, a place dedicated to caring for pets and their families, would show more compassion and understanding in a situation like this.

I respect the importance of appointment times and understand that schedules must be maintained. However, I believe a little understanding and flexibility can make a big difference for pet owners who are genuinely trying their best.

took my 10 month old cat here to get spayed.  I went here because two people told me it’s affordable and easy to get an appointment. But on tuesday I had noticed little rice like specks around my house which i originally thought was from her scar. I was wrong, she had tapeworm. She got tapeworm from eating a flea which she could have only done so from their establishment because I do not have fleas in my home and she is an indoor only cat. So i called over there and left a message someone got back to me within a few hours and they said they could schedule an appointment to get her looked at, but they didn’t have any availability for almost 2 weeks out. Considering my cat is already going through so much at one time i thought they would be more accommodating but they were not so i hung up. I ended up taking her to Caring Hands Veterinary and they could see her and give her treatment within two hours after i called them that tuesday, and now she is tapeworm free. Basically they were kind here and treated my cat right but just be sure your pet is on some kind of
flea treatment before you take your pet here for a procedure because once you drop them off you have no idea what is going to happen.

Hi Donnamarie - you seem to have us confused with another organization. We are an animal rescue and ONLY offer pet adoption; we do not sell animals. Initially it was for a senior wellness check, but turned into us making the decision to putting sweet old Winnie to rest. Mara double checked everything with the medical staff, informed me what I needed to bring, the cost, cremation etc. She was super understanding and supportive. On the day of the appointment, we were greeted with kindness and support. They had set up a room for us to be in with Winnie. Both the tech Analise, and Doctor Duffy, as well as Mara were super professional, friendly and supportive throughout the whole process, continuously checking in to see if there was anything that we needed. Everything went really smoothly and Winnie passed very peacefully. We opted for private cremation thru Pet Meadow, and when I picked up Winnies ashes the other day, the staff at PAWS had gotten us paw prints, nose prints and  card signed by several of the staff members. You can really tell that they care, not only about the pets that are brought in, but also for the owners. I can only highly recommend this place to anyone and everyone who needs to have their pets seen. ❤️🐾

I recently scheduled a neuter appointment for my 6.5-month-old puppy at PAWS, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the entire experience. From start to finish, the process was smooth, efficient, and professional. After placing a deposit ($50) to reserve the appointment, I promptly received a follow-up email with a pre-surgery eligibility form to ensure my puppy was a good candidate for the procedure. Once the form was completed, the appointment was confirmed without any hassle.

On the day of the surgery, check-in was quick and well-organized. I dropped my pup off around 8:25 AM, and the staff was warm, reassuring, and clearly experienced. He was ready for pick-up by 2:30 PM, and the discharge process was just as seamless. They provided an e-collar along with post-op medication and clear instructions for aftercare.

I also appreciated that vaccines were offered as part of the visit, which added an extra layer of convenience. Within just a few days, his incisions healed beautifully and he was back to his playful, energetic self.

If you’re looking for an affordable veterinary service that doesn’t compromise on quality or compassion, I highly recommend PAWS. They made what could have been a stressful day into a smooth, stress-free experience for both me and my puppy.
